tabs.label: Sections
field.token_hint: The part after the colon next to your Telegram ID in VF_USERS on the server.
wizard.title: Agent setup
wizard.lead: Four steps, and what you say into the gamepad shows up in the game chat.
wizard.url_hint: Starts with wss://. Plain ws:// is only for your home network.
wizard.mode_addon_hint: The chat window never opens. The addon picks party, raid or dungeon itself and answers the last whisper.
wizard.mode_chat_hint: No addon. The agent opens the chat with Enter and types /p, /g, /w.
wizard.connect_on_start: Connect as soon as the agent starts
wizard.check_checking: Connecting to the server, waiting up to 15 seconds for an answer…
wizard.check_ok: The server answered and accepted the token.
wizard.check_auth: The server did not accept the token ({detail}). Compare it with the VF_USERS line on the server.
wizard.check_failed: Could not connect: {detail}. The agent keeps trying by itself, you can go on with the setup.
wizard.check_replaced: Another agent just connected with this token.
status.connecting: Opening the connection, waiting up to 15 s for an answer
status.auth_failed: {detail}. Check the token in the settings
status.replaced: Someone connected with this token from another computer
status.not_configured: Fill in and save the settings first
status.idle: Messages from Telegram won't reach the game now
status.test_hint: The line goes to /say as soon as the WoW window is active.
status.test_wait: Waiting for the WoW window: {s} s left
game.active_hint: Messages go to chat right away.
game.background_hint: A message waits up to {s} s for you to come back to the game.
game.closed_hint: The agent finds the window when the game starts.
msgs.title: Recent messages
msgs.empty: Nothing yet. Say something into the gamepad, to the bot in Telegram, or press “Test in /say”.
msgs.not_focused: Not sent: the WoW window was not active
msgs.not_focused_note: The WoW window did not become active within {s} s, the message was not sent.
msgs.skip_note: Doesn't look like a chat message, nothing was sent.
msgs.empty_voice: Didn't catch a word, nothing went to chat
voice.too_long: the recording is longer than it accepts
voice.unsupported: does not take voice from the agent, it needs an update
settings.url_hint: wss:// over TLS. ws:// only on your own network.
settings.mode_addon_hint: The chat never opens, the addon picks party, raid or dungeon itself.
settings.mode_chat_hint: No addon: the agent opens the chat with Enter and types /p, /g, /w.
settings.ptt_enabled: Record voice with a gamepad button
settings.max_record_hint: After this long the recording stops by itself and goes to chat.
settings.ptt_sounds: Sound at the start and end of a recording
settings.game_window_hint: The agent types only into the active game window. A matching window title or process name is enough.
settings.open_delay: Pause after opening the input box
settings.close_to_tray: The cross hides to the tray
settings.language_hint: Changes right away. The Telegram bot has its own: /language.
settings.saved_reconnecting: Saved. Reconnecting with the new settings…
hotkey.capturing: Press a key combination… Esc cancels
hotkey.changed: Change the key in the game too: /vf key {binding}
hotkey.hint: Must match the key /vf shows in the game. The addon goes into the Interface\AddOns folder.
detect.hint: Press, then switch to the game within 5 seconds: the agent adds its window and process itself.
detect.countdown: Switch to WoW. I'll remember the active window in {s} s.
detect.missed: The agent's window stayed in front. Press again and switch to the game in time.
detect.added: Added to the lists, don't forget to save.
mic.no_sdl: The microphone doesn't work while the agent can't find SDL3.dll.
mic.testing: Say something: the bar should reach the middle.
mic.idle: The agent listens to the microphone only while recording.
pad.press: Press a button on the gamepad…
pad.none: No gamepad found. Connect it, the agent notices by itself.
pad.not_running: the gamepad and microphone are not running
pad.stopped: the gamepad and microphone stopped, details in the log
ptt.toggle_hint: Press, speak, press again, and the text goes to chat. No longer than {s} s.
ptt.hold_hint: You speak while you hold the button. Let go, and the text goes to chat.
ptt.warn_chat: Without the addon the game gets this press too. Pick a button that does nothing in the game.
ptt.warn_rightstick: In WoW Forever the right stick places pings. The addon takes this button for itself; you can move pings to another one in the game's controller settings.
ptt.warn_share: The agent sees the Share button through GameInput: restart the agent after changing the button. The game most likely can't see it, so there may be no recording badge in the game.
ptt.warn_other: The addon takes this button from the game while it is on. The in-game check shows what was on it.
test.connect_pad: Connect the gamepad to test your voice.
test.hold: Hold {button}, say “Hello everyone” and let go.
bind.title: In-game check
bind.row_game_now: Waiting for Wow.exe. Log in with a character.
bind.row_focus_now: Switch to the game, the agent does the rest.
bind.row_sent_now: The addon asks for the button: press {button}.
bind.was_on_detail: The addon took it while it is on. You can move that action to another button in the game's controller settings.
bind.was_free: The button was free, the addon took it
bind.err_addon_missing_hint: Check that VoiceForever is enabled in the AddOns list and press “Check again”.
bind.err_wrong_button_hint: {detail}. Check again and press {button} in the game.
bind.err_no_game_folder_hint: The addon took the button anyway: it wrote what was on it into the game chat.
bind.err_chat_mode_hint: The check works only in addon mode.
bind.intro_addon: Start WoW and log in with a character. The agent hands the button to the addon, the addon checks the key bindings and reloads the interface.
bind.intro_chat: Without the addon there is nothing to check: the game gets the press too. Make sure this button does nothing in the game.
bind.line_chat: Without the addon the game sees this button too.
bind.line_taken: In the game the addon holds the button. Before, it was “{name}”.
bind.line_free: In the game the addon holds the button, it was free.
bind.line_unchecked: In the game the addon takes the button. Check what was on it.
bind.d_chat_mode: the check works only with the addon
bind.d_not_focused: the game window was not active
bind.d_no_folder: game folder not found, see the result in the game
bind.d_addon_missing: the addon did not answer: is VoiceForever enabled in the AddOns list?
bind.d_no_result: the addon did not save the result, try /reload in the game
bind.d_wrong_button: the button “{pressed}” was pressed in the game, but recording is set to “{wanted}”
badge.skip: Skipped: doesn't look like a chat message
badge.bad_audio: The recording didn't reach the server
badge.unsupported: The server doesn't take voice from the agent
badge.timeout: The server didn't answer in time
badge.error: Not sent, details in the agent window
net.not_websocket: no WebSocket server at this address
net.timeout: the server did not answer within {s} s
net.replaced: another agent connected with this token
net.auth: the server did not accept the agent token
net.dropped: the connection to the server dropped
net.voice_timeout: the server did not answer in time
net.crashed: internal agent error, details in the log
cfg.server_url: Enter the server address, for example wss://vf.example.com/ws
cfg.server_url_scheme: The address must start with wss:// or ws://
cfg.token: Paste the agent token from VF_USERS on the server
cfg.token_short: Token from VF_USERS: at least {n} characters, no spaces
cfg.hotkey: Needs a key, for example ctrl+shift+f12
cfg.window_or_process: Needs at least one game window title or process
cfg.ptt_mode: Recording mode: "toggle" (press, press again) or "hold" (hold the button)
cfg.mic: Needs a microphone name or an empty string
tray.replaced: the agent is connected on another PC
tray.hidden: The agent stays connected. Click the icon to open the window.
tray.lost_title: Lost the connection to the server
tray.auth: Open the agent window and check the token in the settings.
tray.replaced_title: The agent is connected on another PC
tray.replaced_text: This agent disconnected. You can connect it again from the window or the icon's menu.
dialog.no_dotnet:
The agent window did not start: .NET Framework did not load.

Details in the log:
{log}

Without the window the agent runs like this: VoiceForeverAgent.exe --headless
